https://towersemi.com/2026/09/23/0923202.text_excerpt: Tower Semiconductor to Showcase Technology Innovation and Industry Leadership at its 2026 Technical Global Symposium in the United States - Tower Semiconductor Skip to content Customer Portal | Careers | EN | JP Customer Portal | Customer Portal (ITAR) | Careers | EN | JP Search Tower Semiconductor to Showcase Technology Innovation and Industry Leadership at its 2026 Technical Global Symposium in the United States Home » Press Releases Tower Semiconductor to Showcase Technology Innovation and Industry Leadership at its 2026 Technical Global Symposium in the United States MIGDAL HAEMEK, Israel, – Sept 23, 2026 – Tower Semiconductor (NASDAQ/TASE: TSEM), the leading foundry for high-value analog semiconductor solutions, today announced its 2026 Technical Global Symposium (TGS), to be held on November 17, 2026, in Santa Clara, California, USA. Bringing together customers, partners and industry leaders, the event will explore technologies and market trends driving and shaping the evolution of AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, advanced connectivity, and intelligent sensing. Attendees will have the opportunity to engage directly with Tower’s executive leadership, technology experts, and ecosystem partners. Following the highly successful 2026 Technical Global Symposium in Shenzhen, China, the U.S. event marks Tower’s second Technical Global Symposium of the year, underscoring the Company’s commitment to deep global customer engagement, industry collaboration and technology leadership across key semiconductor markets. The event will feature a CEO keynote session as well as an executive industry panel featuring senior leaders from leading technology companies. Featured panelists include Oliver Sun , CTO, TeraHop; Hong Liu , VP & Fellow, Google AI22; Julie Sheridan Eng , CTO, Coherent; and Andy Bechtolsheim , Founder and Chief Architect, Arista. The panel will examine the evolution of next-generation data center architectures and the technologies enabling the rapid expansion of AI-driven infrastructure. Panelists will discuss perspectives on the opportunities, challenges, and semiconductor innovations required to support future computing and connectivity demands. Technical sessions led by Company executives will showcase Tower’s advanced and differentiated process technologies, including its market-leading, high-volume silicon photonics (SiPho), SiGe, RF and RF SOI, power management, sensors and displays platforms, alongside dedicated sessions on design enablement and aerospace and defense solutions. Participants will gain insights into the last technology developments, future platform roadmaps and emerging applications shaping key high-growth markets. For additional information, the agenda, and registration details, please visit the event webpage here. About Tower Semiconductor Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ/TASE: TSEM), the leading foundry of high-value analog semiconductor solutions, provides technology, development, and process platforms for its customers in growing markets such as consumer, industrial, automotive, mobile, infrastructure, medical and aerospace and defense. Tower Semiconductor focuses on creating a positive and sustainable impact on the world through long-term partnerships and its advanced and innovative analog technology offering, comprised of a broad range of customizable process platforms such as SiPho, SiGe, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/CMOS, RF CMOS, CMOS image sensor, non-imaging sensors, displays, and integrated power management (BCD and 700V). Tower Semiconductor also provides world-class design enablement for a quick and accurate design cycle as well as process transfer services including development, transfer, and optimization, to IDMs and fabless companies. To provide multi-fab sourcing and extended capacity for its customers, Tower Semiconductor currently owns one operating facility in Israel (200mm), two in the U.S. (200mm), and two in Japan (200mm and 300mm) which it owns through its 51% holdings in TPSCo and shares a 300mm facility in Agrate, Italy with STMicroelectronics. (NASDAQ: IBRX), a commercial-stage immunotherapy company, today announced that Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong, its Founder, Executive Chairman and Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer, will participate virtually in a fireside chat at the Piper Sandler Virtual Oncology Symposium, taking place October 15-16, 2026. Details of the event are provided below: Piper Sandler Virtual Oncology Symposium – Fireside Chat Participant: Patrick Soon-Shiong, M.D., Founder, Executive Chairman and Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer, ImmunityBio Moderator: Ted Tenthoff, Managing Director and Senior Research Analyst, Piper Sandler Date: Friday, October 16, 2026 Time: 1:00-1:25 p.m. ET Please contact Piper Sandler for information about attending the symposium and accessing session recordings. “We welcome the opportunity to join Piper Sandler and the investment community to discuss ImmunityBio’s progress and our vision for transforming cancer care by activating the body’s innate and adaptive immune systems,” said Patrick Soon-Shiong, M.D., Founder, Executive Chairman and Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer of ImmunityBio. “With the continued advancement of ANKTIVA ® (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept-pmln) and our broader immunotherapy pipeline, we remain focused on translating innovative science into durable treatment options for patients with difficult-to-treat diseases.” About ImmunityBio ImmunityBio, Inc. is a biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and commercializing next-generation immunotherapies designed to activate the patient’s immune system and deliver durable protection against cancer and infectious diseases. Reserve Your Spot September 16, 2026 D-Wave to Host Qubits Asia 2026 Quantum Computing User Conference in Seoul Event to showcase production applications, customer momentum across APAC and advancements in D-Wave’s annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies PALO ALTO, Calif., and SEOUL, South Korea – Sept. 16, 2026 – D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) (“D-Wave” or the “Company”), the only dual-platform quantum computing company providing both annealing and gate-model systems, software, and services, today announced that it will host Qubits Asia 2026: Quantum Realized, a full-day quantum computing user conference on October 28, 2026, in Seoul. Focused on the growing impact of quantum computing across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, the event will spotlight production applications addressing complex business challenges and research advancing scientific discovery, as well as the latest developments in D-Wave’s annealing and gate-model technologies. The conference will bring together D-Wave executives, customers, researchers and industry leaders to share lessons from real-world implementations, exchange best practices and explore opportunities to accelerate quantum computing adoption across APAC. “Countries including Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan are moving decisively to establish global leadership in quantum computing, and D-Wave is helping turn that ambition into measurable results today,” said Dr. Alan Baratz, CEO of D-Wave. “Qubits Asia will demonstrate what leadership looks like in practice by bringing together customers, researchers and industry leaders to accelerate commercial adoption, advance scientific discovery and expand the impact of quantum computing across the region.” Qubits Asia 2026 comes amid continued momentum for D-Wave across APAC, marked by growing customer adoption, strategic collaborations and commercial and research initiatives spanning network optimization, artificial intelligence and machine learning, drug discovery, materials science, semiconductor manufacturing, port operations and more. Qubits Asia 2026 program highlights include: D-Wave CEO Dr. Alan Baratz and Chief Development Officer Dr. Trevor Lanting will share updates on the Company’s annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies, commercial applications and advances in quantum AI. Shuichi Fukuda, a researcher at NTT DOCOMO, Japan’s largest mobile operator, will discuss the company’s two D-Wave-powered quantum computing applications now operating in production and the resulting improvements in network efficiency and performance. Wanki Cho, consulting manager at LG CNS, will discuss how the company is using D-Wave™ technology to enhance 3D CT imaging for manufacturing inspections. Professor Daniel Park of Yonsei University will explore how annealing quantum computing could enhance generative AI workflows. Po-Hsun Fang of National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University will present a quantum annealing framework for reticle optimization in semiconductor manufacturing. Assistant Professor Seon-Geun Jeong of Gyeongsang National University will present research that used D-Wave technology to optimize berth and quay-crane allocation at Busan Port, successfully scheduling more than 50 vessels and 15 quay cranes using real operational data. To register for Qubits Asia 2026: Quantum Realized, visit https://qubitsasia26.dwavequantum.com/ . About D-Wave Quantum Inc. D-Wave is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com . GTC Berlin 2026 Conference FAQs Get answers to the most-asked questions. General FAQs What is the NVIDIA GTC Berlin conference? NVIDIA GTC Berlin is NVIDIA's premier AI conference in Europe and part of the 2026 GTC event series. These conferences bring together developers, researchers, and industry leaders to explore the full AI stack—from chips and infrastructure to models and applications—and discover how accelerated computing is transforming every industry. Is GTC Berlin in-person or held as a hybrid event? GTC Berlin conference and workshop programming will be an in-person event only. The GTC keynote by NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang will be a livestream and there is no registration required to watch. Details on how to watch it will be available on https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/ . When and where will GTC Berlin 2026 take place? The NVIDIA GTC Berlin keynote is scheduled for October 21, 2026, at the Tempodrom, Berlin. The conference will take place at STATION-Berlin on October 20–22, 2026. Conference STATION-Berlin Luckenwalder Str. 4–6 10963 Berlin, Germany Venue Website Keynote Tempodrom Möckernstraße 10, 10963 Berlin, Germany Venue Website Who should attend GTC Berlin 2026? GTC Berlin offers sessions and training for all technical levels and interest areas of technology. It’s a unique conference that brings together developers, researchers, business leaders, IT decision-makers, creators, and the NVIDIA partner ecosystem. Where can I find the list of sessions at GTC Berlin, how can I build my personal agenda? The GTC Berlin session catalog is available here and you can add sessions using the button ‘Add to Calendar’. What language will sessions and content be presented in at GTC Berlin? GTC Berlin presentations and content will be presented in English. Is there a high-level schedule of everything happening at GTC Berlin? Yes. View the daily Schedule at a Glance here . What is the GTC Berlin 2026 program schedule? NVIDIA GTC Berlin program breaks out as follows: Training Workshops: Tuesday, October 20 Keynote: Wednesday, October 21 Conference: Wednesday, October 21–Thursday, October 22 Exhibits: Wednesday, October 21–Thursday, October 22 How can I contact the conference organizers? If you have a question that wasn’t answered here or you have general feedback, please contact us at GTC_registration@nvidia.com . Is there a shuttle service available? Yes, there is a shuttle service from selected locations. See here for the timetable and details on pickup/drop-off locations. Registration FAQs How do I register for GTC Berlin 2026? GTC Berlin is currently sold out. Please join our waitlist here and we’ll notify you if we have additional passes available for purchase. How much does GTC Berlin 2026 registration cost? The prices for all GTC Berlin passes include VAT. You will see the VAT called out separately during the registration process. Is VAT included in the registration pricing for GTC Berlin 2026? The prices for all GTC Berlin passes include VAT. You will see the VAT called out separately during the registration process. Are there any discounts available for GTC Berlin 2026? Yes, we offer discounts for education, nonprofit, and government sectors. View the registration packages and pricing page for more information. Do I have to register to attend the GTC Berlin conference sessions? Yes, registration is required to attend GTC Berlin sessions. I’m under the age of 18. Can I register for GTC Berlin? The minimum age to attend GTC Berlin in person by yourself is 18. What method of payment is accepted for registering for GTC Berlin? We accept credit and debit (bank) cards as a method of payment. Your registration must be paid in full to attend the conference. What description or company name will appear on my credit card statement when I register? After registering for GTC Berlin, the transaction will appear on your credit card or bank statement as “RAINFOC*NVIDIA GTCEU26". Where can I find the receipt or invoice confirming my registration for GTC Berlin? Click here to log in to your attendee portal, navigate to “My Registration”, then click on “Download Invoice(s)” in the top right corner. Is there a deadline to register for GTC Berlin? There’s no deadline to register, but it’s very likely that the event will sell out, so early registration is recommended. What’s the cancellation policy for GTC Berlin? If you can’t make the event, please submit your cancellation requests at GTC_registration@nvidia.com . The following processing fees will apply: Before 8:59 a.m. CET, Tuesday, September 22, 2026: A €25 processing fee/cancellation penalty will apply. After 8:59 a.m. CET, Tuesday, September 22, 2026: No refunds will be granted. No-shows are ineligible for workshop refunds. Substitution requests will be granted but must be received by 8:59 a.m. CET Saturday, October 10, 2026. If you’re having difficulty registering online, please email GTC_registration@nvidia.com , and we'll be happy to assist you. I’m no longer able to attend GTC Berlin. Can I transfer my registration to a colleague? Substitution requests will be granted but must be received by 8:59 a.m. CET, Saturday, 10 October 2026. To transfer your registration to a colleague, please email GTC_registration@nvidia.com . Can I be denied registration to GTC Berlin? NVIDIA reserves the right to deny registration to any individual or entity for any reason, at our sole discretion. These include past or present failure to meet NVIDIA’s standards of conduct, as well as (but not limited to) engaging in violent, illegal, threatening, or discriminatory conduct. View the GTC Berlin Code of Conduct. Keynote FAQs How can I attend Jensen Huang’s keynote at GTC Berlin? Conference pass holders will have access to attend the live keynote address with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. There is limited seating so plan to arrive early before the keynote. You can also watch the keynote online. Find out more at www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/ . What is a keynote watch party? A watch party is a digital event where virtual participants watch the livestream of the keynote session with peers, including interactive activities. This is a fun way to participate in the keynote if you’re unable to get an actual seat at the keynote venue. Do I need to register to watch the keynote? Yes, registration is required to attend the GTC keynote in person. Viewing online virtually is free and doesn't require registration. Can I pick up my badge at the keynote venue? Yes, registration at Tempodrom will open at 8:30 a.m. How can I attend Jensen Huang’s keynote? Conference pass holders will have access to the live keynote address with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. Exhibits Only pass holders are welcome to join any of the keynote watch parties. FAQs for Speakers and Sponsors Is there a call for submissions for GTC Berlin? Can I submit a talk proposal? For GTC Berlin, all talks and panels are curated. We are not currently accepting proposals. Whom should I contact for more information on sponsorships or exhibiting at GTC Berlin? GTC Berlin sponsorships and exhibiting opportunities are by invitation only. If you’d like to express interest should space become available, please email GTC-Sponsors@nvidia.com . How can I contact the GTC Berlin conference organizers? If you have a question that wasn’t answered here or you have general feedback, please contact us at GTC_Registration@nvidia.com .
